originalTitle: Oil prices fall for fifth day after Trump says U.S. met with Iran for three hours
summary: Oil prices reversed early gains on Tuesday amid optimism that prospects for a diplomatic solution to the U.S.-Iran war are improving.
content:
Crude oil prices fell for a fifth consecutive session Tuesday after President Donald Trump said the U.S. held hourslong talks with Iran.

Brent crude futures, the international benchmark, fell 1% to close at $99.25 a barrel. West Texas Intermediate shed 1.2% to settle at $94.59. Prices are down more than 4% this week but are still up more than 9% on the month.

Trump said the U.S. met with Iran's delegation for three hours on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York City. "It was a very good meeting," Trump told reporters during a bilateral meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the U.N.

In his address to the U.N. earlier Tuesday, Trump said he has a "big decision" to make on whether to seek a negotiated deal with Iran or "annihilate the Islamic Republic."

"I believe we'll make a deal right after the election because it doesn't make sense for them not to," Trump said in his address. "They're waiting to see how I do in the midterm election. What they don't realize is that I'm not running."

Trump said the U.S. military has recently escorted more than a billion barrels of oil through the Strait of Hormuz. More oil is flowing through the strait under U.S. military protection than at any previous point of the war, he said.

Iran's president, Masoud Pezeshkian is attending the U.N. General Assembly. Trump told Fox News on Sunday that he was open to meeting Pezeshkian. Every attempt at a negotiated settlement between the U.S. and Iran so far has collapsed into renewed fighting.

There were signs that the supply crunch in the Middle East could ease this week. Saudi Arabia is in the early stages of restarting its critical East-West pipeline, people familiar with the matter told Bloomberg News . Riyadh aims to restore meaningful flows by Saturday, one of the people told Bloomberg .

Sources told Reuters that the pipeline was already pumping at a low rate and could resume exports at the port of Yanbu on the Red Sea later Tuesday.

The Saudis closed the pipeline after it sustained damage in a drone attack launched from Iraq on Sept. 10. The pipeline has played a crucial role in diverting Saudi crude oil exports to the Red Sea as the U.S. and Iran battle for control of the Strait of Hormuz.

Riyadh has diverted oil back through Hormuz during the pipeline closure.

Ras Tanura, a port on Saudi Arabia's east coast, had its busiest loading day since before the war started on Feb. 28, according to maritime data firm Kpler . Six supertankers loaded nearly 12 million barrels at Ras Tanura and Juaymah on Monday, according to Kpler.
chineseTitle: 特朗普表示美国与伊朗会面三个小时后油价连续第五天下跌
chineseSummary: 由于人们乐观地认为外交解决美伊战争的前景正在改善，油价周二扭转了早盘涨幅。
chineseContent:
在唐纳德·特朗普总统表示美国与伊朗进行了数小时的会谈后，周二原油价格连续第五个交易日下跌。

国际基准布伦特原油期货下跌 1%，收于每桶 99.25 美元。西德克萨斯中质原油下跌 1.2%，收于 94.59 美元。本周价格下跌超过 4%，但本月仍上涨超过 9%。

特朗普表示，美国在纽约联合国大会期间会见了伊朗代表团三个小时。特朗普在联合国与乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行双边会晤时对记者表示：“这是一次非常好的会面。”

特朗普周二早些时候在联合国发表讲话时表示，他要做出一个“重大决定”，是寻求与伊朗谈判达成协议，还是“消灭伊斯兰共和国”。

特朗普在讲话中表示：“我相信我们会在大选后立即达成协议，因为他们不这样做是没有意义的。” “他们正在等着看我在中期选举中的表现。他们没有意识到我没有参加竞选。”

特朗普表示，美国军方最近已护送超过10亿桶石油通过霍尔木兹海峡。他说，在美国军事保护下流经该海峡的石油量比战争之前的任何时候都要多。

伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安正在出席联合国大会。特朗普周日告诉福克斯新闻，他对会见佩泽什基安持开放态度。迄今为止，美国和伊朗之间通过谈判解决的每一次尝试都陷入了新的战斗。

有迹象表明中东的供应紧缩本周可能会缓解。知情人士告诉彭博新闻社，沙特阿拉伯正处于重启其重要的东西方管道的早期阶段。一位知情人士告诉彭博社，利雅得的目标是在周六之前恢复有意义的资金流动。

消息人士告诉路透社，该管道已经在低速抽水，周二晚些时候可能会恢复红海延布港的出口。

9月10日，该管道在伊拉克发动的无人机袭击中受损，沙特关闭了该管道。在美国和伊朗争夺霍尔木兹海峡控制权之际，该管道在将沙特原油出口转向红海方面发挥了至关重要的作用。

在管道关闭期间，利雅得已将石油通过霍尔木兹引回。

据海事数据公司 Kpler 称，2 月 28 日，沙特阿拉伯东海岸港口 Ras Tanura 迎来了战争爆发前以来最繁忙的装货日。据 Kpler 称，周一，六艘超级油轮在 Ras Tanura 和 Juaymah 装载了近 1200 万桶石油。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
